extracted.stage: Divorce proceedings, costs for counsel and forensic accountant
extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about a £6,500 litigation loan for a husband in divorce proceedings where around £84,500 of property and pension assets are in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client. We have noted the request for £6,500 towards counsel, expert and solicitor costs, with assets in dispute of approximately £84,500 in property and pensions. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, the current stage of proceedings and any listed hearing dates, details of the assets offered as security, and your client's identity and contact details. We will send our criteria and application form separately, and a colleague will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
